title: Set a user-specific locale on Arch Linux
summary: Override the system locale for your specific user account. This allows you to use a different language or date format than the system default.
prerequisites: The desired locale must already be generated.

steps.explain: Create or edit the user-specific locale configuration file. Add the LANG variable with your desired locale.
steps.gui: Create a file named locale.conf in ~/.config/ and add the line LANG=<LOCALE_ID>
